hookups.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/tobyhanna-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880420 (per-site catalog: all 26 Modern Electric sites list 50-amp; no site lists water or sewer hookups), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 130 family campsites on the booking site (26 Modern Electric, 104 Modern Non-Electric) besides 5 walk-to organized group tenting sites; DCNR calls it a 135-site camping area. Listed max vehicle lengths are mostly 15-45 ft (about 100 sites take 25 ft or more), three take 50 ft and one 65 ft. Every site is listed back-in.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/tobyhanna-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880420 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

values.note: Flush toilets, showers and water spigots in one central location; playground. The dump station is between the park office and the campground entrance. Pets at selected sites for a fee. The booking page lists the nearest camp store as outside the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/tobyhanna-state-park/stay ('Flush toilets, showers, and water spigots are provided in a central location', 'a sanitary dump station located between the park office and the campground entrance') + ReserveAmerica Services and Amenities for parkId 880420 ('Nearest Camp Store Outside The Campground'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). Check-in and check-out 3 p.m.

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/tobyhanna-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880420 (Booking Window for Modern Electric and Modern Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

note: Some sites from 91-131 may have partial lake view, of which CampsitePhotos recommends 101, 111, 113, 115, 117, and 119 --Claude  Tobyhanna Lake is to be drawn down from spring 2027 to December 31, 2028 for dam and dredging work; the lake, boat launches and swimming area close to the public then, while the modern campground stays open (ReserveAmerica alert, read 2026-10-20). --Claude
summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (mid-April to mid-October) already manual. Added 50-amp electric (26 sites), 130 family campsites to 65 ft, all back-in, showers/flush toilets/water/dump, no camp store on site; added the 2027-2028 lake drawdown to the note. Not stated for this park: water/sewer at sites, min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'lakeview'. ReserveAmerica tags 21 campsites 'Waterfront' (Modern Non-Electric sites 95-129 odd and 130-132, 15-40 ft; the RV-category ones are 95-105, 111-119 and 123-132), yet every one of them also lists 'Distance to Lake/Stream: Greater than 300 feet', so the tag contradicts itself. Check those pads against the lake shore on satellite.
